open_findings.title: Ungating unique-scan-counts widens a grid-500 blast radius from ~29 orgs to every ADMIN/USER org
open_findings.detail: resolveCurrentMonthFromCold() is DELIBERATELY catch-free and is not guarded by the failure marker. Pre-diff, a non-entitled org was routed to lockedStat() and never called getMonthlyData(). Decision 2 deleted that gate, so with scans_cold hard-down the whole Company Metrics grid now 500s for every org, not just the ~29 entitled ones. CompanyMetricsOverview::getStats() has no per-card try/catch. The class docblock records the SCAN-VOLUME cost of ungating but not the RELIABILITY cost.
open_findings.note: This is a consequence of an operator decision, not a coding slip. It may be acceptable — but it was never stated when the decision was made.
open_findings.resolution: human:Dalton chose option 1. Driver verified against the merge-base that the POPULATION claim is wrong: ScanCount was itself ungated, was in the pre-diff registry, and its resolveCurrentMonthFromHot() was equally catch-free — so every ADMIN/USER org ALREADY reached an unguarded scans_cold read on every render. Ungating did not widen the exposed population; it added a second unguarded leg to the same path. Docblock now states the reliability posture explicitly. No behavioural change.

open_findings.title: A failed total-scan fetch renders as genuine zero data rather than unavailable

open_findings.resolution: human:Dalton — "Fix R4-E". Added $totalUnavailable + a local UNAVAILABLE_VALUE, set on both the failure guard and the marker-suppressed path; description renders "-- total scans"; getData() drops the Total Scans dataset; refreshData() resets the flag. Three mutations checked independently. Test stub deliberately fails the total leg while the UNIQUE leg stays healthy (the only shape producing the impossible reading) and lets the current-month leg SUCCEED (it is catch-free by design, so a throw there is a different failure mode).
